title: How Volcanoes Erupt: Earth's Fiery Release

scenes.title: Earth's Pressure Release Valve
scenes.narration: Volcanoes are Earth's powerful vents, releasing immense pressure and heat from deep within. Did you know over 1,500 active volcanoes exist globally, constantly reshaping our planet?

scenes.title: Magma's Journey Upward
scenes.narration: It all begins with magma, molten rock formed deep in Earth's mantle. Being less dense, this buoyant magma slowly rises through cracks, much like a hot air balloon ascending.

scenes.title: Pressure Builds in the Chamber
scenes.narration: Magma collects in a magma chamber beneath the volcano, like a balloon filling with air. Dissolved gases, primarily water vapor and CO2, create immense pressure, seeking an escape.

scenes.title: The Eruption: Release of Energy
scenes.narration: When pressure exceeds the rock's strength, the volcano erupts! This can be a gentle flow of lava, like Hawaii's Kilauea, or explosive blasts of ash and gas, like Mount St. Helens.

scenes.title: Shaping Landscapes, Impacting Climate
scenes.narration: Volcanic eruptions are powerful geological forces, creating new landforms and influencing global climate by releasing gases and ash. They are a constant reminder of Earth's dynamic nature.
